slot_f0_0x6076030.map_header: header at out+0x08 (colour +0x08, root +0x10, left +0x18, right +0x20, count +0x28)
slot_f0_0x6076030.node_layout: RB-tree node 0x48 bytes: colour/parent/left/right at +0x00/+0x08/+0x10/+0x18, std::string key at +0x20 (pointer +0x20, length +0x28, SSO buffer +0x30), u64 value at +0x40
slot_f0_0x6076030.returns: false (0) iff out is null, without locking; true (1) after the fill, including an empty ticker vector
steps: Null map: return false immediately, no lock taken.

Free the old map contents: walk the tree from the root at out+0x10, freeing each right subtree through _Rb_tree::_M_erase 0x60700d0, each heap string buffer (skipped when the string pointer equals its own SSO buffer at node+0x30) with its length+1, and each 0x48-byte node; then re-initialise the header (root out+0x10 = 0, left out+0x18 and right out+0x20 = &header at out+0x08, count out+0x28 = 0).
Lock the mutex at this+0x38 via 0x60d5230 (call site 0x60760f4).
Walk the BSS ticker vector at 0x6506260 ({begin, end} of 0x28-byte entries: u32 ticker id at +0x00, name pointer at +0x08), in vector order; an empty vector jumps straight to unlock.

Per entry: sum the ticker over its shards via 0x6070430(this, id) (call site 0x6076133); build a std::string key from the name (inline SSO buffer at rsp+0x80 for length <= 15, heap buffer via _M_create above that; a null name throws logic_error with the message at 0x963298).

Insert through the inlined RB-tree lower_bound (memcmp on the shared prefix, then the length difference against the 0x80000000 bound) plus _Rb_tree_insert_and_rebalance for a new node (0x48 bytes; key string copied into the node, length+1 bytes including the terminator); a key already present keeps its node and takes the new summed value at node+0x40 (last duplicate wins).
Unlock via 0x60d52f0 (call site 0x6076385) and return true.

Exception path: the landing pads funnel into the shared cleanup fragment 0x6075ff6..0x607602a (its own FDE), which disposes the temp string, unlocks the mutex, checks the stack canary and resumes unwinding.

ticker_getter_0x6070430.contract: sum over 2**(u8 at this+0x68) shards of the u64 at *(this+0x60) + shard*0xce40 + ticker*8 (ticker is zero-extended from u32)

tree_erase_0x60700d0.contract: _Rb_tree::_M_erase: recursively free the subtree rooted at the argument node (right spine unrolled, self-recursion at 0x6070174); per node, free the heap string buffer when the key pointer differs from the node's SSO buffer at node+0x30 (length+1 bytes), then free the 0x48-byte node; a null argument returns at once
